subject: general
question: Bodo language is spoken mainly in which of the following states of India?
solution:
The correct answer is**__ ​Assam__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bodo language is spoken mainly in Assam.**
 
• Boro, also called Bodo, is the largest ethnolinguistic group in the Assam state of India. 
 
• They are spread across north-eastern India. 
 
• They are concentrated mainly in the Bodoland Territorial Region of Assam, though Bodos inhabit all other districts of Assam and Meghalaya. 
 
• Bodos are officially identified as "Boro, Borokachari" scheduled tribe under the Constitution of India. 
 
• Bodos speak Bodo language, which is recognised as one of twenty-two Scheduled languages of India.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• ​In May 2022,** President Ram Nath Kovind** attended the concluding session of the** 61st Bodo Sahitya Sabha at Kachubri in Tamulpur district, Assam**.
 
• It was a historic moment for Bodo Sahitya Sabha as no President of India has ever participated in a literary program of any language in the Northeast region.​
